title: Cascade Vision Network Provider Manual: In-Network Copays, Allowances and Discounts
content:
**Section — Member cost at participating locations (Vision Plans)**

**Clauses in force**

- **Materials copay.** One materials copay applies per materials purchase. When lenses and a frame are ordered on the same claim it is taken once, on the lens service. When only a frame is ordered it is taken on the frame. It is taken on elective contact lenses only when the plan's contacts allowance is used.
- **Frame benefit.** The frame benefit pays up to the plan's frame allowance for a participating independent practice, or up to its frame allowance for a participating retail-chain location. At an independent practice the member also receives the plan's frame overage discount off the amount above the allowance. That discount is not given at retail-chain locations.
- **Elective contact lenses.** Elective contact lenses receive the plan's elective contacts allowance; the member pays any amount above it, with no discount.
- **No benefit on the plan.** A plan without a lens, frame or contacts benefit denies that service as not covered, and the member may buy it at the plan's materials discount off retail.
- **Rounding.** Amounts are rounded half up to the cent.

**Frame member share, stated as a definition.** The frame allowance is the independent-practice allowance at an independent practice and the retail-chain allowance otherwise. The overage discount is the overage discount percent of the amount by which the retail charge exceeds that allowance (zero when it does not), rounded half up to the cent, at an independent practice, and nothing at a retail-chain location. The member's frame share is the amount above the allowance, less the overage discount, plus any copay taken on the frame.

*Worked example (hypothetical figures).* Independent practice, frame allowance 130.00, overage discount 20%, frame retail 171.85, frame ordered alone with a materials copay of 25.00. The amount above the allowance is 41.85; the discount is 8.37; the member pays 41.85 less 8.37 plus 25.00, which is 58.48. At a retail-chain location with an allowance of 70.00 and the same frame, the member pays 101.85 plus 25.00, which is 126.85, with no discount.

**Clauses no longer in force.** The following clauses of this section are no longer in force; they have been superseded by the current basis in the vision claim rules:

1. *No longer in force:* "In network the routine exam costs the member the exam copay and the plan pays the rest of the provider's contracted exam fee; a standard contact-lens fitting costs the member at most the standard fitting maximum, and a specialty fitting receives the specialty fitting allowance with the member paying the rest."
2. *No longer in force:* "Spectacle lenses are covered after the materials copay plus the copay for their lens type and each ordered lens option; polycarbonate is covered in full for a patient under the child age limit when children's polycarbonate is covered."

superseded_clauses: In network the routine exam costs the member exam_copay and the plan pays the rest of the provider's contracted exam fee; a standard contact-lens fitting costs the member at most contact_fitting_standard_copay_max, and a specialty fitting receives contact_fitting_specialty_allowance with the member paying the rest.

Spectacle lenses are covered after the materials copay plus the copay for their lens_type and each ordered lens option; polycarbonate is covered in full for a patient under child_age_limit_years when child_polycarbonate_covered is true.
